name: Eminem
hook: A Detroit rapper discovered by Dr. Dre from a demo tape, who let Weird Al parody 'Lose Yourself' but refused him a video.
blurb: Eminem, born Marshall Mathers in St. Joseph, Missouri, in 1972, settled in Detroit at 12. Dr. Dre heard his demo after a rap competition, the 1997 Rap Olympics, and signed him to Aftermath and Interscope in March 1998, and Dre produced 'The Slim Shady LP' (1999), which made him famous. 'The Marshall Mathers LP' (2000) sold 1.76 million copies in its first week in America, and 'The Eminem Show' was 2002's best-selling album in the world. 'Lose Yourself' (2002), from the film '8 Mile', in which he starred, was number one for 12 weeks and won the 2003 Oscar for Best Original Song, the first for a hip-hop act. Through the 2000s GLAAD and others condemned his lyrics as homophobic and violent.
